database: libSQL/SQLite (local file for development, Turso server database for deployment)

units.see_duration: minute, converted from actual seconds and rounded to one decimal place

date_rules.start_date_end_date_deadline: start_date is a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; end_date and deadline are YYYY-MM-DD or an empty string when unset; overdue compares nonempty deadline with today's Asia/Seoul date and excludes completed or deleted tasks
date_rules.timestamps: UTC ISO 8601 strings; display in Asia/Seoul
date_rules.duration: ended_at minus started_at in whole seconds, calculated on the server

completion_events.primary_key: id (random 16-byte hex text generated by the database trigger)

bootstrap_runs.purpose: initial-records-v1 is applied transactionally at most once; later edits and deletions never trigger a reset

aggregate_rules.planned_count: nondeleted tasks belonging to the selected plan
aggregate_rules.completed_count: those tasks whose current status is completed
aggregate_rules.overdue_count: those tasks still open with a nonempty deadline before today's Asia/Seoul date
aggregate_rules.blocked_count: unique nondeleted tasks with at least one nonempty work_log.blocker_reason
aggregate_rules.estimated_minutes: sum of estimate_minutes over nondeleted tasks
aggregate_rules.actual_minutes: sum of actual_seconds over logs attached to nondeleted tasks divided by 60, rounded to one decimal place
